greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Kwanga uThixo uBawo, osinika ithemba elingapheliyo, angaba nani nonke namhlanje.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi ngenxa yokuba siphazame ngokuphila kwethu. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi ngenxa yokuba ngamanye amaxesha ithemba lethu liyancipha. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi kwaye usinike amandla amatsha.
psalm_response: Nkosi, xa ubuqaqawuli bakho bubonakala, uvuyo lwam luya kuzala.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso ohlala unamathele engqondweni yam xa ndicinga ngoBenjamin Vo. Hayi indiza enkulu esibhakabhakeni, hayi ikhompyutha ayeyikodileyo, kodwa umzuzu othi cwaka ekhitshini. Khumbula uBen ehlezi phantsi, enxibe iibhulukhwe zakhe eziluhlaza, ephethe isilawuli somdlalo, amehlo akhe ecinga nzulu ngento ethile ebalulekileyo. Kwakukho ukuzola okumangalisayo kulo mfana. Wayengumfana owayebona ihlabathi ngenjongo, owayefuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu ukuya kwindlela yokwakha 'con chim airlines' yakhe—kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encane eyayiqonda ukuba uthando luyinto yokwenziwa, hayi yokuthethwa nje.

Namhlanje, uPawulos oNgcwele usibuyisela kwisiseko sokholo lwethu. Uthi: 'Kodwa ngoku uKristu uvusiwe kwabafileyo, isiqhamo sokuqala sabo babethilele.' La magama awakho nje ekuthetheni; ayisisiqalo esibonisa ukuba ubomi bomntu ngamnye buxhunywe kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen wayephila ngaloo ndlela. Khumbula indlela awayenomsa ngayo, umzekelo xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe—isipho somntu owayemi elulwini lokuba angazigcineli nto, kodwa anikele ngayo yonke into ayenayo. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila.

Kodwa masime apha phambi kweVangeli. UYesu uhamba ukusuka kwidolophu ukuya kwidolophu, ekhapha abafundi bakhe kunye nabafazi ababemkhonza ngezinto ababenazo. Le Vangeli isikhumbuza ukuba uYesu akahambi yedwa. Uphila nabantu bakhe. UBen, ngoku, akahambi yedwa. Usebanquet yasezulwini, ecaleni kukaSanti Carlo Acutis, umfana owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba le mibuzo ayiphefumli lula kwizindlu zenu namhlanje. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu, ukuba isitulo sakhe esisezantsi singekho, nokuba umoya wakhe usasele phakathi kweendonga zendlu. Usizi aluhambi ngeendlela ezilula. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni, ukuba ingaba sikhona na isigwebo esifihlakeleyo, ukuba ingaba ikhona na into eninokuyenza ngcono ukuba uBen abe nathi ixesha elide. Ndicela niphulaphule amazwi am namhlanje ngokucacileyo: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto nize nenza ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala ncam. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo, olufana nalo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe egameni lakhe eCà Mau, olethela abantu abaswele ubomi.

UYesu uthi kuwe namhlanje: 'Ndiya kuniphendula.' UThixo uva ukukhala kwenu. UThixo uva ukubetha kwentliziyo yakho, Ryan, xa ucinga ngomfowenu. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana onezandla ezivulekileyo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa.

Namhlanje, xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente yothando. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizibophelele kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndohlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Kwangathi uThixo angaligcina uthando lwenu luphilile kwaye aninike uxolo oludlula ukuqonda konke. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abaselizini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele anike iintliziyo zabo ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, ukuba uKristu ushumayelwa ukuba uvukile kwabafileyo, banjani na abanye phakathi kwenu abathi akukho kuvuka kwabafileyo? Ukuba akukho kuvuka kwabafileyo, noKristu akavukanga. Ukuba ke uKristu akavukanga, asilolize ke ukushumayela kwethu, asilolize nokukholwa kwenu. Sifunyanwa ke singamangqina obuxoki ngoThixo, ngokuba sangqina ngoThixo ukuba wamvusa uKristu, amvusa angamvusa ukuba inene abafileyo abavuswa. Kuba ukuba abafileyo abavuswa, noKristu akavukanga. Ukuba ke uKristu akavukanga, ukukholwa kwenu akulolize; nisezezono zenu. Ke abo balalayo kuKristu batshabalala. Ukuba sithembe kuKristu kulo bomi bodwa, singabona bantu banesijwili phakathi kwabantu bonke. Kodwa ngoku uKristu uvusiwe kwabafileyo, isiqhamo sokuqala sabo babethilele.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Nkosi, xa ubuqaqawuli bakho bubonakala, uvuyo lwam luya kuzala. Yiva, Nkosi, ityala elilungileyo; phulaphula ukukhala kwam; thambisa indlebe emthandazweni wam ovela emilebeni engenakukhohlisa. R. Nkosi, xa ubuqaqawuli bakho bubonakala, uvuyo lwam luya kuzala. Ndiyabiza kuwe, kuba uya kundiphendula, Thixo; thambisa indlebe yakho kum; yiva ilizwi lam. Bonisa iinceba zakho ezimangalisayo, O msindisi wabo babalekela ekuzimeleni ngasekunene kwakho. R. Nkosi, xa ubuqaqawuli bakho bubonakala, uvuyo lwam luya kuzala. Ndifihle emthunzini wamaphiko akho. Kodwa mna ngobulungisa ndiya kububona ubuso bakho; xa ndivuka, ndiya kwaneliswa bubukho bakho. R. Nkosi, xa ubuqaqawuli bakho bubonakala, uvuyo lwam luya kuzala.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wahamba esuka kwidolophu ukuya kwidolophu, eshumayela evakalisa iindaba ezimnandi zobukumkani bukaThixo. Wayehamba nabafundi abalishumi elinesibini, kunye nabafazi ababéphilisiweyo kwimimoya emibi nasezintlungwini, uMariya okuthiwa uMagdalena, owaphuma kuye iidemon ezisixhenxe, uJowana umfazi kaKuza, umphathi-ndlu kaHerode, uSusanna, nabanye abaninzi ababebancedisa ngezinto zabo.

day: Friday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
